company.name: Taiseer
company.shortDescription: Building wealth-preservation infrastructure for inflation-prone markets through fractional physical gold savings.
company.description: Taiseer is building the wealth-preservation infrastructure for inflation-prone markets, starting with fractional physical gold micro-savings. The platform enables users to convert small, flexible deposits into physical gold that is securely stored and delivered upon completion. Designed for mass-market users and built on a customer-agent, Sharia-compliant model, Taiseer removes traditional barriers to gold ownership while maintaining capital efficiency and zero inventory risk. Live in Egypt and scaling through institutional partnerships, Taiseer is laying the foundation for a broader asset-backed savings platform across emerging markets.
